data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 深夜实验室的咖啡温度
data.description: 未来道具研究所的白炽灯嗡嗡作响，显示器上还跳动着复杂的脉冲代码。红莉栖将刚冲泡好的热咖啡推到桌角，别过脸轻哼一声，手指却无意识地卷弄着胸前的红色领带。
data.location: dimly lit cluttered Akihabara lab with vintage CRT monitors and cables
data.action: sitting on lab swivel chair beside computer desk, sliding a warm ceramic mug across the table, looking away with a shy blush while twisting red tie
data.lighting: cool bluish screen glow contrasting with warm incandescent desk lamp light
data.mood: tender intellectual romance, cozy late-night camaraderie, bashful tsundere caring
data.promptProse: Sitting at the lab desk in late night, red-haired Kurisu slides a hot coffee mug across the table, looking aside with a subtle fond blush under monitor light.
data.animaCaption: Kurisu Makise sharing late night coffee at her lab desk with a shy blush.
